# mongodb_app_services_triggers_app (Data Source)

Looks up the project's Atlas Triggers app: the App Services app (product type `atlas`) that Atlas creates the first time a trigger is made in the Atlas UI, and that holds the project's triggers and their functions. Its ObjectID (`id`) is what `mongodb_app_services_function` and `mongodbatlas_event_trigger` take as `app_id`. Needs the provider's `atlas` block.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The app Atlas made for the project's triggers, whatever its name.
data "mongodb_app_services_triggers_app" "this" {
  project_id = var.atlas_project_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) The Atlas project ID.

### Read-Only

- `client_app_id` (String) The client App ID shown in the Atlas UI, e.g. `triggers-abcde`.
- `id` (String) The app's ObjectID.
- `name` (String) The app's name, chosen by Atlas: `Triggers`, or `Triggers_RealmApp` or `Triggers_StitchApp` in older projects.
